records.question: Tom reads 10 hours over 5 days.  He can read 50 pages per hour.  Assuming he reads the same amount every day how many pages does he read in 7 days?
records.response:
Tom reads 10 hours/5 days = 2 hours/day.
So he reads 2 hours/day * 50 pages/hour = 100 pages/day.
In 7 days he reads 100 pages/day * 7 days = 700 pages.
#### 700
